relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: Eckel received his B.A. in English from Harvard University

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: subsequently earned a B.A. and M.A. in Theology from the University of Oxford

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: He completed his Ph.D. in the Study of Religion at Harvard University in 1980.

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: Eckel began his academic career as an Instructor in Religion at Middlebury College from 1978 to 1980

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: joining Harvard Divinity School, where he served as Assistant Professor from 1980 to 1985

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.role: Senior Lecturer in the History of Religions
relations.evidence: and Senior Lecturer in the History of Religions from 1989 to 1991.

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.object: Harvard’s Center for the Study of World Religions
relations.evidence: During this period, he also held administrative appointments at Harvard’s Center for the Study of World Religions, including Administrative Director.

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: In 1990, Eckel joined Boston University, where he served as Associate Professor of Religion from 1990 to 2009

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: and later Professor of Religion from 2009 to 2024.

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: He was appointed Professor Emeritus in 2024.

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.role: Visiting Associate Professor of Buddhist Studies
relations.evidence: Eckel also held a visiting appointment as Visiting Associate Professor of Buddhist Studies at the University of Michigan in 1987

relations.subject: Malcolm David Eckel
relations.evidence: served as Visiting Professor of Buddhist Studies at the University of Sydney in 2013.
